data.name: Heading
data.value: Community Data Review Panel

data.name: Section1
data.value: The Community Data Review Panel is the ethical conscience of Kindred Labs. Established under the Kindred Labs Codex, the Panel holds independent authority to review and approve every dataset used in the training and development of KindredAI. Without CDRP approval, no dataset may be used. That authority is not advisory — it is binding.

data.name: Section2Heading
data.value: What the CDRP Does

data.name: Section2Content
data.value: The Panel reviews training datasets for provenance, consent documentation, representational diversity, and alignment with the Codex doctrine of Empathetic Pluralism. It participates in Codex amendment reviews and holds veto power over datasets that fail to meet the Foundation's ethical standards. A two-thirds vote of the Board of Directors is required to override a CDRP veto — and only under narrowly defined conditions.

data.name: Section3Heading
data.value: Who We're Looking For

data.name: Section3Content
data.value: The Panel is designed to reflect the full breadth of human experience. We are looking for people who represent communities that have historically been underrepresented or harmed by automated systems — not just researchers or technologists, though those perspectives matter too. What matters most is the ability to evaluate data through the lens of lived experience, critical thinking, and a genuine commitment to fairness.

data.name: Section3Terms
data.value: Members serve one-year renewable terms. Service is voluntary. Members may not hold paid positions at Kindred Labs during their tenure.

data.name: Section4Heading
data.value: The Panel Is Not Yet Seated

data.name: Section4Content
data.value: Kindred Labs is currently seeking founding members of the CDRP. Founding members will help shape not only the datasets that train KindredAI, but the processes and standards by which future datasets are evaluated. This is a meaningful role with real authority in a governance structure designed to last.
